release_notes: **Dashboard Table view**: a **Cards / Table** toggle next to the Strategies filters. The table shows one row per strategy with Mode (and Re-arm when unarmed), Automation, LIVE/SIM position status (including MANUAL and EXIT UNCONFIRMED), live P&L with a stop-loss-to-target gauge, entry, exposure and margin, next run, and last run. It refreshes on the same cycle as the cards, and the Mode and Auto-on-only filters apply to both views. **Details**, **Log** and **Sq Off** stay pinned to the right edge, and clicking the strategy name also opens the Trade Status details. Your chosen view is remembered in the browser.
